rows.ARS:
Light pink.
Registration name: ADAssili
Exhibition name: Carole Bouquet
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, 2000).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2006 as 'Martina Mondadori'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink. Strong, fruity fragrance. 35 to 40 petals. Average diameter 5.25". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 31" to 4'7" (80 to 140cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous. produces decorative hips.
rows.Parentage:
Silver Jubilee ® (hybrid tea, Cocker before 1974) ×
Ville de Liffré (hybrid tea, Adam)
